description: Predict replication origin and terminus from cumulative GC-skew extrema: origin ~ prefix index of the minimum, terminus ~ prefix index of the maximum; also returns all minimizing/maximizing indices (Rosalind BA1F) and supports a circular flag (positions mod n). Optional windowSize = Grigoriev windowed cumulative skew (window centres; linear only); optional skewIndexWindow adds the SkewIT Skew Index (skewi.py). Best on complete circular bacterial genomes.

circular.description: Treat the input as a circular chromosome: prefix index n = junction 0, positions reported mod n in [0, n-1]. Not combinable with windowSize

windowSize.description: Grigoriev (1998) window in bp: origin/terminus = centre of the first adjacent complete window with min/max running sum of (G-C)/(G+C); position arrays empty. Omit for the per-base walk

skewIndexWindow.description: SkewIT window k in bp (SkewIT default 20000): adds skewIndex (Lu & Salzberg 2020, exactly skewi.py)

originPositions.description: All prefix indices minimizing the cumulative skew (Rosalind BA1F answer), ascending

terminusPositions.description: All prefix indices maximizing the cumulative skew, ascending (empty with windowSize)

skewIndex.description: SkewIT Skew Index in (0, 1]; null when not requested or when skewi.py reports none

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
circular is not supported with windowSize (the windowed Grigoriev prediction is linear)
Window size must be at least 1
Skew index window must be at least 1

examples.name: Windowed prediction + Skew Index on the Rosalind BA1F sample
